scientific_integrity: All finite frequencies were enumerated using exact integer arithmetic with independent butterfly and dynamic-programming algorithms; symbolic auxiliary lemma proved in the result. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact 1296-dimensional Fourier nullity and first cubic blind-spot cutoff are certified only at dimensions up to 13, not beyond. Priority against unindexed exact Walsh spectra remains open. The auxiliary run-length congruence is a straightforward weighted-enumerator consequence and is not asserted to be the novel part.
title: First cubic Walsh blind spots in the thirteen-dimensional generalized Fibonacci cube
